subject: Randomly pulling data from/writing to CSV via R Shiny

messages.author: 29499d848a9e4159
messages.subject: Randomly pulling data from/writing to CSV via R Shiny
parts:
Hi all -

I'm interested in using R Shiny to rate company mission statements. I want to be able to pull a stored mission statement from a CSV file I have saved locally, have someone rate it based on certain parameters, then write those ratings in the same CSV file. Is this possible? If yes, how would I go about implementing it? I have the backbone of the app and it spits out an output, but I've hard-coded a mission statement into it and I can't get it to write to a CSV file. 

Thanks in advance for your help!
